title: What Is 3D Printing?
caption: Imagine building something from nothing, one thin layer at a time! That's 3D printing, also called additive manufacturing.

title: How a 3D Printer Works
caption: Let's meet the parts of an FDM 3D printer! Plastic string called filament starts on a spool.

title: Stay Safe in the Maker Space
caption: Great makers are safe makers! The nozzle gets very hot, and so does the build plate, so never touch them while a printer is running or cooling.

title: Choosing Your Material
caption: Different jobs need different filaments! PLA is the best choice for school.

title: Design Your Own in CAD
caption: Every print starts as an idea on a screen! CAD means computer-aided design, and there's free software to try.

title: Find Free 3D Models
caption: You don't always have to start from scratch! Free libraries are packed with ready-to-print models.

title: Slicing: Model to Layers
caption: A printer can't read a 3D model directly.

title: Fix Common Print Problems
caption: Even experts have prints that go wrong, and that's okay! Warping is when corners curl up.

title: From Idea to Business
caption: Your invention could be a real business! First, make a prototype and test it.

title: Your Capstone Invention
caption: It's time for your big project! Start by finding a real problem, then design a solution in CAD.

title: 3D Printing for VEX Robotics
caption: Want a faster, smarter robot? Print your own custom parts! Make sensor mounts, cable guides, and intakes that fit your exact design.

title: Your Take-Home Project
caption: Time to make something to keep! Grades five and six build the Desk Buddy Bot, a snap-together pen-holder robot with a swivel head and a name plate.
